extraction: lxml main itertext, trim each text node and join with LF; pre.text_content retained as original_prompt; no typo or markdown unescaping
discovery: public site-map plus index pages; no authenticated pages or undocumented APIs
limitations: Not a benchmark release or proof of production-host completeness.
Robots endpoint retrieval returned 403; no crawl API or change feed established. Future unattended collection must review access policy.
Two dot-containing routes required their linked trailing-slash URLs; initial failures retained in research notes.
HTTP headers unavailable on a few initially cached pages; empty objects indicate unknown, not absent upstream.
Raw response HTML hashes retained; HTML not redistributed. Extracted text, prompt bytes, links and dates are archived.
